engine: Microsoft Edge via Playwright, headless, local HTTP only
scope: Local gallery bytes, image decoding, filtering, dialog, mobile layout and navigation. Does not accept artwork, approve a look or plan, verify lip-sync, or accept animation.

visual_review.method: Actual view_image inspection of the three generated browser screenshots after automated run.

observations.desktop: At 1360 x 1000 the header, navigation, two filters, count and five-column gallery are legible. Thumbnails retain contain framing; no visible control/card overlap.
observations.modal: Shen full-body portrait displays within the dialog from crown to both feet. Caption and close button are visible. Automated Escape check passed.
observations.mobile: At 390 x 844 text wraps within viewport, navigation and both selectors remain visible, count wraps to its own line, and two-column cards remain within width. Lower card text naturally continues below the viewport and is scrollable.

limits: Only the three browser screenshots were visually inspected in this verification; the 146 original artworks were not individually re-reviewed here.
PNG SHA/dimensions and actual browser decode were checked for all 146 images.
This report confirms gallery rendering/interactions only; it does not accept artwork, validate animation/lip-sync, grant formal look approval, or authorize paid production.

portable_path_normalization.scope: Path serialization only; no browser rerun. Existing image/gallery/index/verifier-executed SHA and manual review evidence retained.
portable_path_normalization.note: inputs.verifier.sha256 records the version used for the existing browser run; the later serializer-only change is recorded separately.
